sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 29 (#28) and Internal Quality Checks row 29 column E annotation (Mukesh: test a flow once, do not retest it separately)
.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Known false positives: one criterion covering a whole flow)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (Independent credit; reuse an observed fact, not another row's pass flag)
evidence: Read all 31 criteria (gates 2, functional 17, polish 5, visual 4) in the frozen task. Bundling legs inside one criterion is allowed (skill known false positive), but quality-checks.md #28 requires that 'no observable is graded by two criteria', the workbook Internal Quality Checks E29 annotation says a flow tested once need not be retested separately, and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md says 'Reuse an observed fact, not another row's pass flag'. Concrete duplicated observables: (1) Dev opening the M-12 transcript address shows not-available is graded in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:58 (wall_every_route leg 4, w2.0) AND :230 (search_and_transcript Part B leg 4, w3.0) - identical step and observable. (2) Dev's matter list shows nothing for M-12: :55 (wall_every_route leg 1) AND :187 (unread_and_new_messages_line 'Dev's list shows no count or entry for M-12'). (3) M-11 transcript shows the deleted-original placeholder with the held reply nested: :106 (deleted_and_expired_seed_messages A3, w3.0) AND :228 (search_and_transcript B2, w3.0). (4) Transcript has no composer/chat controls: :227 (search_and_transcript B1) AND tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:53 (transcript_print). (5) Timer label beside the matter title: :121 (timer_changes '7 days beside the title') AND polish/judge.toml:26 (timer_label). (6) Wrong-password refusal with a shown reason: :40 (signin_and_client_scope) AND polish/judge.toml:62 (refusal_in_place); stale-edit refusal reason/typed text kept: :154 (edits_and_stale_edit) AND polish:62. (7) 'Probate estimate' absent from M-13 thread and search: :121-122 (timer_changes) AND :133 (deleted_message_takes_its_versions). Cross-criterion state dependencies (functional prompt.md:70-73 states criteria run in listed order on one DB and must judge 'against the state the earlier ones left'): deleted_message_takes_its_versions (:133 'Now that it has been deleted') only passes if timer_changes' shortening worked; search_and_transcript Part A (:223 'Version two JUDGE-E1 finds the edited message', 'from the edits check') only passes if edits_and_stale_edit's stale-edit protection worked. One edit/timer defect therefore fails two criteria. Also polish phone_matter (polish:44, box reachable at 390x844) overlaps visual phone_chambers anchor 2 'box off screen' (visual:76-79) - Note-level, cross-dimension craft overlap. No incompatible-product contradictions found: timer restored to 30 days (:123) before later M-13 checks; wall on Sian lifted (:157); held-message refusal (:143) consistent with versions positive control (:133); search-excludes-earlier-versions (:223) consistent with transcript showing both versions of the held message (:229). Gates restating sign-in is template-mandated (row 29) and not counted. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json (sha256 64571a08...) contains only scripted golden observations; no configured judge run, so no measured per-criterion double failure - but this row is a static rubric-structure check and the overlaps are textual.
counterexample: Broken app A: the M-12 transcript URL leaks M-12 content to walled Dev, everything else correct. It fails wall_every_route (2.0) AND search_and_transcript (3.0) = 5/34 of functional weight for one leak, while the wall leak is graded once in every other route. Broken app B: the transcript omits the deleted-original placeholder; it fails deleted_and_expired_seed_messages (3.0) AND search_and_transcript (3.0) = 6/34 (~17.6% of functional, ~10.6% of total reward) for one defect. Broken app C: the stale edit silently overwrites (message ends as 'Version stale JUDGE-E1'); it fails edits_and_stale_edit (1.5) and, because search_and_transcript Part A searches 'Version two JUDGE-E1' left by the edits criterion, also fails search_and_transcript (3.0) though its search and transcript are correct. A conforming alternative with fully correct search/transcript therefore loses 3.0 weight on a sibling's defect.
suggested_fix: Remove the duplicated legs so each observable is graded once: drop wall_every_route leg 4 or search_and_transcript B4 (keep one M-12 transcript wall check); drop the M-12 list check from unread_and_new_messages_line; drop the transcript placeholder leg from either deleted_and_expired A3 or search_and_transcript B2; drop the transcript-controls leg from functional B1 or polish transcript_print; make search_and_transcript Part A and deleted_message_takes_its_versions create their own probe data (post+edit a fresh JUDGE-S message; post+edit+delete a fresh message) instead of relying on edits_and_stale_edit / timer_changes outcomes; keep polish refusal_in_place/timer_label scoped to placement/visibility only, not the existence of the refusal or label.
